sourceText:
Bifteki - Μπιφτέκι
By: Philippos
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:49pm

Ingredients




1 pound ground beef
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 cup chopped onion
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon black pepper
1 teaspoon oregano
2 eggs
1 cup breadcrumbs
1 large tomato sliced
1 cup chopped parsley

Preparation

1 Combine ground beef, olive oil, onion, salt, pepper, oregano, eggs, breadcrumbs, and parsley in a large bowl and mix with your hands. 2 Divide mixture and form 6 patties. 3 Place patties in a pyrex and place a piece of sliced tomato on each patty. 4 Heat the broiler at 500 degrees and cook for 30 minutes or until desired. 5 Enjoy.

About


My mom made this often. It's a widely popular dish in Cyprus.
